summary: Major coding assistants now recognize repository-wide and path-scoped instruction files, while code-intelligence tools retrieve local context. The concrete value is a small, verified route to authoritative workflows and code, not a large generic repository synopsis.

items.text: GitHub Copilot supports repository-wide copilot-instructions.md, path-specific instruction files, and nearest-scope AGENTS.md files; the documentation explicitly targets project understanding plus build, test, and validation guidance.

Claude Code loads project CLAUDE.md files and path-scoped rules at session start and can import linked files; its documentation recommends concise, specific instructions and distinguishes context from enforced policy.
VS Code recognizes workspace custom instructions and file-pattern-scoped instructions, allowing module-specific conventions and workflow links to apply only when relevant files are being edited.

Sourcegraph Cody builds context through code search and code-graph signals and accepts explicit files, symbols, repositories, and selections, supporting an entry-point-first workflow followed by targeted retrieval.

Backstage TechDocs places repository-built documentation beside catalog ownership and service metadata, making a stable module or service landing page discoverable without embedding all details in agent context.
